combo.description: R into melee range then W AA Q as quickly as possible. After your Q pretend to walk away then R and turn back around to finish off your kill with AA Q, then using E to leap away.
While in melee range AA W and as quickly as possible E away from your target and Q instantly while in the air.
To double jump E past your target then Q to kill them mid air. Before you hit the ground, E again.

Your basic R combo using the first R into melee range then AA Q quickly. Follow up by using AA W then repositioning/resetting your passive with R until your next Q cooldown. Finish off the kill by using AA Q.
Your basic assassination combo will be to W and instantly E, then Q your target mid air and AA when you land.
When engaging use E then Q your target mid air and land with an AA W.
To fully all in an opponent R then E out of stealth and Q mid air. Land then AA W AA and R to reposition, then AA Q.
W and instantly Flash onto your target to AA Q.
When someone facechecks W then instantly Q AA.
To quickly burst R into melee range then AA and W Q straight after.
